sections.accountDesc: Login credentials and basic personal details.

sections.medicalDesc: Health notes and who to contact in an emergency.

hints.name: Required. The student's full name as it should appear on official documents.
hints.email: Required. Used for login, must be unique — no two accounts can share the same email.
hints.username: Required. Used for login alongside email, must also be unique.
hints.password: Required. At least 8 characters. The student can change it later from their account.
hints.passwordHint: Optional. Leave blank to keep current password — fill only to set a new password.
hints.gender: Required. Used for records and to direct the student to gender-appropriate facilities when needed.
hints.birthDate: Optional. Used to calculate age and verify eligibility for the selected grade level.
hints.nationalId: Required only if available, per school policy. Used for official identification.
hints.phone: Optional. A direct contact number for the student, if available.
hints.active: Controls login access. Deactivate to prevent the student from logging in without archiving their record.
hints.academicYear: Required. The academic year the student is enrolled in — determines the available classes below.
hints.currentClass: Optional until the student is assigned to a class. Only shows classes belonging to the selected academic year.
hints.admissionDate: Required. The date the student officially joined the school.
hints.admissionNumber: Optional. Leave blank to auto-generate based on the academic year.
hints.rollNumber: Optional. An internal number used in class attendance lists.
hints.scholarshipPercentage: Optional. The discount percentage applied to this student's fees, from 0 to 100.
hints.isGraduated: Indicates the student has completed their studies. Leave unchecked for currently enrolled students.
hints.fatherName: Optional. Used for correspondence and emergency contacts.
hints.fatherPhone: Optional. A direct number to reach the student's father.
hints.motherName: Optional. Used for correspondence and emergency contacts.
hints.motherPhone: Optional. A direct number to reach the student's mother.
hints.guardianName: Optional. Fill if the primary guardian is someone other than the parents.
hints.guardianPhone: Optional. A direct number to reach the guardian.
hints.guardianRelation: Optional. The guardian's relationship to the student, e.g., uncle or grandfather.
hints.address: Optional. The student's home address, for correspondence and records.
hints.city: Optional. The city where the student resides.
hints.bloodGroup: Optional. Recorded only for medical emergencies.
hints.allergies: Optional but recommended. List any known allergies the staff should be aware of.
hints.medicalConditions: Optional but recommended. Any relevant medical conditions affecting the student's care at school.
hints.previousSchool: Optional. The name of the school the student previously attended, if any.
hints.emergencyContactName: Recommended. The person to contact first in case of a medical or security emergency.
hints.emergencyContactPhone: Recommended. A reachable number for the emergency contact.
hints.emergencyContactRelation: Optional. The emergency contact's relationship to the student.

sections.accountDesc: Login credentials and basic personal details.

hints.name: Required. The guardian's full legal name, as it should appear on official documents.
hints.email: Required. Used to sign in and must be unique — no two accounts can share an email.
hints.username: Required. Used to sign in alongside the email, and must also be unique.
hints.password: Required. At least 8 characters. The guardian can change it later from their account.
hints.passwordHint: Optional. Leave empty to keep the current password — fill it in only to set a new one.
hints.phone: Optional. A direct contact number for the guardian.
hints.nationalId: Optional. Used for official identification, according to school policy.
hints.occupation: Optional. The guardian's occupation, recorded for reference.
hints.active: Controls sign-in access. Turn off to block the guardian from logging in without archiving their record.
hints.relationship: Required. How this guardian is related to the selected student, e.g. father, mother, uncle.

hints.name: Required. The display name of the class, e.g., 'Grade 3' or 'Science A'.
hints.sectionCode: Required. A short code identifying the section, e.g., 'A' or '1'. Must be unique within the same academic year and grade level.
hints.capacity: Required. The maximum number of students this class can accommodate. Must be at least 1.
hints.academicYear: Required. The academic year this class belongs to — determines the available section codes.
hints.gradeLevel: Required. The grade level taught in this class.
hints.branch: Required. The school branch where this class is held — determines available classrooms below.
hints.classroom: Optional. The classroom assigned to this class. Only shows rooms belonging to the selected branch.
hints.classTeacher: Optional. The teacher primarily responsible for this class.
hints.assistantTeacher: Optional. A supporting teacher who assists the class teacher.
hints.active: Controls whether the class is available for new enrollments. Deactivate to hide it without archiving.
